lanes.legend: Dots are lanes leading in, rings lanes leading out. Click a lane in, then a lane out to add the way between them or take it away.
lanes.every.tooltip: Gives the junction a lane for every way through again, as it was made
lanes.none.tooltip: Takes every way through the junction away, so you can connect the lanes anew; until you do, AI traffic cannot pass it. Ctrl+Z brings them back.
lanes.turn.title: Left-turn lanes
lanes.taper.tooltip: How long the median's kerb takes to lead back to its full width beyond the storage
lanes.storage.tooltip: How long the turn lane runs at its full width before the stop line, for the cars waiting to turn
lanes.hint: Esc: let go of the lane, then leave.
lanes.turn.remove: Remove from arm {n} ({direction}), {taper, number, 0.#} + {storage, number, 0.#} m
lanes.turn.add.tooltip: Takes a left-turn lane out of this arm's median, with the taper and storage above; the road joined to it is cut back to make room
lanes.turn.remove.tooltip: Gives the median back its full width up to the mouth
lanes.turn.lengths.tooltip: Makes this arm's left-turn lane as long as the taper and storage above
lanes.done.every: Every lane in leads to every lane out again
@lanes.done.changed: {way} is a way such as 1.0>2.1, shown unchanged
lanes.done.way_added: Added the way from arm {from} to arm {to}
lanes.done.way_removed: Took away the way from arm {from} to arm {to}
lanes.done.turn_removed: Took the left-turn lane of arm {n} away
lanes.done.turn_added: Added a left-turn lane to arm {n} with {taper, number, 0.#} m of taper and {storage, number, 0.#} m of storage
lanes.done.turn_changed: Gave the left-turn lane of arm {n} {taper, number, 0.#} m of taper and {storage, number, 0.#} m of storage
lanes.status.first: Lanes: click a junction made in this project first.
lanes.status.mismatch: Junction #{id} cannot be made again: its connection points do not match its file.
@lanes.status.layout_failed: {reason} is a message from the system or the layout, in English
@lanes.status.no_turn: {reason} is a message from the system or the layout, in English
lanes.status.start: Lanes: click a junction made in this project to choose its ways through; Esc leaves the tool.
lanes.click_junction: Click a junction made in this project.
lanes.status.transition: Object #{id} joins two cross-sections; it has no ways through to choose.
lanes.junction: Junction #{id}: {arms, plural, one {# arm} other {# arms}}, {count} of {total} ways through.
lanes.status.target: Lanes of junction #{id}: click a lane in (dot), then a lane out (ring) to add or take away the way between them.
lanes.plan.choose: Click to choose this lane in.
lanes.plan.pick_in: Click a lane in (dot) to see where it leads.
lanes.plan.same_arm: A lane cannot lead back into its own arm.
lanes.plan.remove: Click to take this way away.
lanes.plan.pick_out: Click a lane out (ring) to add or take away the way to it; Esc lets go of the lane.
lanes.status.chosen: Lane in chosen: click a lane out to add or take away the way to it.
lanes.status.in_first: Lanes: click a lane in (dot) first, then this lane out.
lanes.status.own_arm: Lanes: a lane cannot lead back into its own arm.
lanes.status.only_made: Lanes: click a junction made in this project; only those can have their ways through chosen.
@lanes.status.stays: {reason} is a message from the system or the layout, in English
lanes.stays.default: the roads at it cannot be kept as they are.
lanes.status.rebuild_failed: The junction could not be made again: {reason}
@lanes.status.rebuild_failed: {reason} is a message from the system or the layout, in English
lanes.status.rebuild_failed_id: Junction #{id} could not be made again: {reason}
@lanes.status.rebuild_failed_id: {reason} is a message from the system or the layout, in English
lanes.status.stays_refs: Junction #{id} stays: {references} still need it as it is.
@lanes.status.stays_refs: {references} is a list of what names the junction, written by the program
lanes.status.done: {done} (junction #{id}); now {count, plural, one {# way} other {# ways}} through, made again as {name}. Ctrl+Z takes it back.
lanes.status.follow: Lanes: click a lane in to see where it leads; Esc leaves the tool.
lanes.crossing.title: Pedestrian crossings
lanes.crossing.distance.tooltip: How far out along the arm the centre of a new crossing lies, measured from where the corner of the junction starts
lanes.crossing.width.tooltip: How wide a new crossing is
lanes.crossing.add.tooltip: Lays a footpath across this arm and cuts its pavement paths where it joins them, so people can change the side of the street; the arm reaches out further to make room and the road joined to it is cut back
lanes.crossing.remove: Remove crossing from arm {n} ({direction}), {distance, number, 0.#} m out, {width, number, 0.#} m wide
lanes.crossing.remove.tooltip: Takes the crossing away and gives the arm its usual length again
lanes.crossing.values.tooltip: Moves and widens this arm's crossing to the distance and width above
lanes.done.crossing_removed: Took the crossing of arm {n} away
lanes.done.crossing_added: Added a crossing to arm {n}, {distance, number, 0.#} m out and {width, number, 0.#} m wide
lanes.done.crossing_changed: Gave the crossing of arm {n} {distance, number, 0.#} m of distance and {width, number, 0.#} m of width
@lanes.status.no_crossing: {reason} is a message from the layout, in English
